messages:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for release/v2.3.0 -> eu-west-1 (canary pool A). tracking: https://deploys.internal/release/v2.3.0 :rocket:
alex: seeing p95 jump on model-inference pods, from ~120ms to ~850ms, started 2m ago :eyes:
jen: ack. how widespread? only canary nodes?
alex: only canary A. 3/10 pods reporting. error traces point to KV cache thrash, increased GC in runtime logs. snippet:
```
[2026-03-21T10:12:03Z] WARN kv_cache.c: evict_miss spike=34
[2026-03-21T10:12:04Z] latency: 840ms path=/v1/model/generate
```
marco: hmm. RBK-17 (canary backout runbook) says: if p95 > 500ms for >5min, pin to last stable and stop rollout. link: https://runbooks.internal/RBK-17
ravi: +1 to pin. last stable is release/v2.2.9 (sha: a1b2c3d).
jen: agree. recommended steps? who will execute pin?
marco: I can do it, will need hands on rollback if pin doesn't halve latency. command: `deploy pin release/v2.2.9 --env=eu-west-1 --scope=canary --reason="latency spike"`
alex: while pinning, we should disable cache prefetch on canary per RBK-17 section 3.2 (quick mitig): `kubectl set env deploy/model-runtime PREFETCH=false -n canary-eu`
ops-bot: RBK-17 checklist (automated):
- Step 1: Notify release lead (jen) :bell:
- Step 2: Pin to last stable (marco)
- Step 3: Monitor p95 for 10m
- Step 4: If no improvement, rollback full canary and open incident
(https://runbooks.internal/RBK-17/checklist)
jen: ok marco, go ahead. alex, prep the cache toggle comms and watch graphs. i'll notify support.availability
marco: executing pin now:
```bash
# pin release
deploy pin release/v2.2.9 --env=eu-west-1 --scope=canary --reason="latency spike"
```
deploy-bot: Pin applied: release/v2.2.9 -> canary eu-west-1 by marco at 1761234578 :white_check_mark:
alex: toggling prefetch now
```bash
kubectl set env deploy/model-runtime PREFETCH=false -n canary-eu
```
alex: done. watching
ravi: monitoring traces and tailing logs, posting any error patterns
ops-bot: Reminder from RBK-17: if cache toggle improves p95 by <30% after 10m, escalate to full rollback and notify SRE pager.
jen: 10m window starts now. will wait for metrics.
alex: 3m in: p95 down to 420ms (from 840). good sign :thumbsup:
marco: nice. keep observing, don't roll forward new shards yet.
ravi: logs show reduced eviction spikes, KV miss down to normal levels.
jen: if stable at 10m, we'll leave pin in place and mark rollout paused. prepare release note: "paused v2.3.0 canary due to KV cache regression; pinned to v2.2.9 in eu-west-1. investigation ongoing."
marco: adding a temporary tag to the canary hosts: `tagging: rollback-protection=manual-pin`
deploy-bot: Rollout paused by jen. action=pin, target=canary eu-west-1, pinned_to=release/v2.2.9, actor=marco, ts=1761234582
jen: filing a short postmortem doc in #postmortems after incident resolved. also updating release notes in the internal changelog.
alex: +1. thanks all. ops-bot, leave RBK-17 link pinned in channel until cleared.
ops-bot: RBK-17 pinned in channel.
marco: summary for next steps: 1) keep canary pinned 2) investigate KV cache change in v2.3.0 compile flags 3) run local repro with same load 4) if fix ready, stage a patched v2.3.0-canary and re-run canary with feature flag OFF for cache prefetch
jen: agreed. I'll coordinate with product for a brief note to PMs. closing this thread once we have 1h stable metrics or rollback required. :lock:"
